task: Review these screenshots (paths relative to the workspace root): design_review/home.png, design_review/catalog.png, design_review/product.png, design_review/thanks.png. Open each one with Read and judge the visual design as described in your instructions.
output:
Reviewed all four screenshots.

**Home** — Header and hero band look clean (dark teal, white text, good contrast). But the four category cards are visually flat: just bold black text in a white box with a thin teal top-edge accent, no icon, no secondary copy, no indication of item count. They read as plain buttons rather than inviting category tiles — the "front door" of the catalog doesn't feel merchandised. Below the cards there's a huge expanse of empty gray space before the footer — roughly 60% of the viewport is dead air, making the page feel unfinished rather than deliberately spacious.

**Catalog** — Good hierarchy (breadcrumb → heading → cards), price is teal and bold against a plain title, which works. But the product images are gray placeholder rectangles with the product name typed as literal text inside them — this reads as a broken/unstyled image state, not a product photo stand-in. With only two products, the grid also leaves a large blank area to the right with no max-width/centering, reinforcing the "unfinished prototype" feel.

**Product page** — Best page of the four: title → price → description → stock-availability pill → "Оставить заявку" form is a clear, logical reading order, and the orange submit button pops nicely against the teal/white palette. Same placeholder-image issue as catalog. Content is pinned to the upper-left quadrant of a wide page, leaving the entire right half blank — feels unbalanced on a real screen.

**Thanks page** — The confirmation box's green left-border accent is a nice, subtle success cue. But the checkmark is a bare "✔" text glyph sitting unstyled above the heading — no circle/badge, no color fill — so it looks like a missing icon rather than a designed success indicator. Same heavy whitespace problem as home: content occupies a small box in the top-left, rest of the page is empty.

**VISUAL: FAIL**
- Replace the plain "✔" on the thanks page with a styled icon (colored circle/badge, e.g. green circle with white check) sized to anchor the heading, not a raw text glyph.
- Give category cards on the home page actual visual weight: add an icon per category, a one-line description or item count, and a hover/shadow state — right now they're indistinguishable from a plain list styled as boxes.
- Replace the gray placeholder-with-text-label product images with either real product photography or a proper placeholder icon (image/box glyph), not literal product-name text inside a box — the current version looks like a broken image.
- Constrain page content to a centered max-width container (or otherwise fill the layout) on home, catalog, product, and thanks pages — all four currently leave 50-60% of the viewport as dead whitespace to the right/bottom, which reads as an unstyled prototype rather than a finished site.
